facts.text: I am planning a baby-themed party for my friends who are adopting a baby boy from the foster care system.
I just saw my newborn nephew Ethan.
My nephew Ethan was born three weeks ago.
I think Ethan's weight of 7 pounds is pretty average.
I want to give my friends a personalized baby blanket with the baby's name embroidered on it.
I gave my coworker Lisa a personalized baby blanket for her baby shower.
My sister-in-law Rachel was really happy with the personalized blanket I gave her for baby Ethan.
I want ideas for a special way to present the blanket at the party.
I decided to use the Blanket Unfolding Ceremony to present the blanket.
I will explain the significance of the gift and why I chose it during the Blanket Unfolding Ceremony.
I will slowly unfold the blanket to reveal the baby's name and the embroidery.
I have a nephew named Ethan.
